commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}"; echo "DEVFLOW_APP_ID=${DEVFLOW_APP_ID:-<unset>}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-}"; echo "session=${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-<none>}"; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---toplevel---"; git rev-parse --show-toplevel

mkdir -p /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp
rm -f /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1163.md
gh issue view 1163 --json body --jq '.body' > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1163.md
head -c 120 /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1163.md; echo; wc -l /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1163.md

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1163.md
gh issue view 1163 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1163.md
wc -l .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1163.md

BODY=$(printf '%s\n' "Work in progress — automated review pending." "" "Resolves #1163" "[View run](https://github.com/The01Geek/prflow/actions/runs/30956961566)" "" "Generated via \`/prflow:implement 1163\`")
if CREATE_OUT=$(gh pr create --base main --draft --title "Drop devflow.yml's two review-triggered subscriptions and pin its four checkouts to the default branch" --body "$BODY" 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\ncreate: ok\n' "$CREATE_OUT"
else
  printf '%s\ncreate: failed\n' "$CREATE_OUT"
fi

mkdir -p /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp
set -- /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json
if [ -e "$1" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before; else : > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before; fi
echo "snapshot lines: $(wc -l < /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before)"

ls -d .prflow/tmp/review 2>/dev/null && find .prflow/tmp/review -name 'iter-*.json' 2>/dev/null | sort | tee .prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before || touch .prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before
echo "baseline lines: $(cat .prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before | wc -l)"

ls .changeset/ && echo "---existing sample---" && head -8 $(git ls-files '.changeset/*.md' | grep -v README | head -1) 2>/dev/null; echo "---parser keys---"; grep -nE "type|bump|frontmatter|\.get\(|required" scripts/consolidate-changesets.py | head -30
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; ls .changeset/ | head; echo "---"; for f in .changeset/*.md; do echo "== $f"; sed -n '1,6p' "$f"; done 2>/dev/null | head -60
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; timeout 300 lib/test/run-module.sh review-trigger-helpers 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; F=.github/workflows/devflow.yml
echo "event_name clauses: $(grep -cE "github\.event_name == '" $F)"
echo "pull_request_review subs: $(grep -cE 'pull_request_review(_comment)?:' $F)"
echo "issue_comment sub lines: $(grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*issue_comment:[[:space:]]*$' $F)"
echo "checkout@v6: $(grep -cE 'actions/checkout@v6' $F)"
echo "review.body: $(grep -cF 'github.event.review.body' $F)"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; ls .changeset/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---existing changeset heads---"; for f in .changeset/*.md; do [ "$f" = ".changeset/README.md" ] && continue; head -4 "$f"; echo "=="; done 2>/dev/null | head -40

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1163/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "trigger comment: $TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"
if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then
  .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction h …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
